name: Black Mamba Scale Armor
body:
Aura: moderate transmutation; CL 8th; Slot: chest; Price: 9,000 gp; Weight: 15 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This armor is made from the scales of dire deadly black mambas. It is equivalent to masterwork leather armor. As a free action, the wearer can activate the armor’s special abilities, allowing him to move faster for up to 10 rounds each day. Activating this ability increases the wearer’s base land speed by 5 ft. In addition, when running, the wearer moves five times his normal speed (if wearing Medium, light, or no armor and carrying no more than a Medium load) or four times his speed (if wearing heavy armor or carrying a heavy load).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells expeditious retreat, haste; Cost: 4,500 gp.
